_comment: Reviewed high/critical advisories accepted until an upstream fix exists. Every entry needs a reason. Remove entries as upgrades land; scripts/ci/audit-deps.mjs reports stale ones.

advisories.title: path-to-regexp outputs backtracking regular expressions
advisories.reason: Transitive via @astrojs/vercel -> @vercel/routing-utils, which compiles route configuration at BUILD time; it does not match live requests. No fixed release on the @astrojs/vercel 11 line yet (npm only suggests a downgrade). Re-check on each adapter release.
